coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with two non-binding advisories. Twenty-three attack vectors run, none landed at any grade. Custody holds in every direction: subject e540ea53 at mode 0444, 32378 bytes, re-hashed unchanged after the pass, unedited and uncommitted; HEAD, the subject's head field and recordedInputs.HEAD are all 1394645; file 08 and COORD are unmodified in the working tree; the last COORD heading is D-227. Forty-six of forty-six digest assertions reproduce from the live tree. Eleven of eleven byte-exact quotes reproduce, including the harness cell, which is byte-identical both to file 08 and to the cell quoted in the dispatch, and including the D-154 draft's own row, which has not drifted from the live register. The decisive measurement is the structural diff against frozen v3. Zero leaf paths were removed, which bounds the entire mutation surface to seventeen changed values, and the evidence core is byte-identical to v3: retainedEvidence in all four entries, both namedCorpusClasses, liveCellMemberSplit, and the three quoted cells. The four prior findings are therefore landed by identity rather than by re-assertion, and I verified each against primary source anyway. The one sentence the dispatch mandated be remasured is remasured exactly: doesNot[7] moves from 'Does not change required-now 26.' to 'Does not change live required-now 28.', the house form character-for-character, and it is the only doesNot line dropped from the v3 roster while the other eight survive and thirteen are added. Every v3 failsIf entry survives; the four asserting the prior findings landed were displaced to failsIf[30:34] byte-identically. required-now 28 I corroborated independently rather than accepting the dispatch: the D-227 body states 'Required-now stays 28' and '4 of 32', file 08 carries thirty-two DR-G rows, and the adopted G27 v2 precedent carries the identical condition-2 sentence. The two attacks I expected to be closest were the harness-spec substitution and the parentReview swap; both are refuted structurally rather than by prose. Closure of OBL-G28-HARNESS-SPEC is attributed to leftover-join.v3 in four places and failsIf[0] names the substitution itself as a failure, while parentReview is the D-154 adversarial review whose dual CONSENT 0/0 I re-measured from both verdict files, with naming v6 explicitly disclaimed as parent and gate-harness-naming.v6.json containing zero occurrences of DR-G28. The re-framing from v3's authoring language to occupancy language is what makes that first refutation possible and I record it as a strength. Two advisories, neither blocking: the remeasurement clause does not name g28-input-corpus.v1 among the files whose movement forces a re-measure, although failsIf[12] can fail the artifact on that basis, and basedOn.d078 carries a recording number with no pin, though its role is a pure disclaimer I verified directly against the subject bytes. My v3 advisory on carried provenance prose going stale was picked up rather than carried. This ACCEPT closes nothing by itself: the artifact claims no new leftover closure, marks no row, and names no obligation as closed by its own existence.
